title: Lancôme unveils ‘I’m Fine’ platform to support women’s mental health and drive ‘positive societal change’
summary: The new global programme by the L’Oréal-owned beauty brand aims to raise awareness around women’s mental health, with Lancôme Brand Ambassadors Demi Moore, Christy Turlington, Zoé Saldaña and Vanessa Kirby sharing personal stories

extraction.key_fact: 랑콤이 여성의 정신 건강을 지원하고 긍정적인 사회적 변화를 이끌기 위한 글로벌 플랫폼을 공개했다.
